description: Gateway to a running Unreal Editor: search capabilities, describe one capability's contract, execute a capability, or configure capability groups.

action.description: Action within the tool, e.g. spawn. Required for execute (unless capability is given).

capability.description: Capability id such as control_actor.spawn; an alternative to tool+action for execute.

consent.description: Consent grant returned by describe for destructive capabilities; required to execute those.

params.description: Parameters for the capability being executed.

query.description: Plain-words capability search, e.g. 'spawn actor'. Required for search.

tool.description: Internal tool name, e.g. control_actor. Required for describe and execute (unless capability is given).

name: unreal
